# subagents for lecture-agent

The goal of subagents is to specialize LLM context, so as to
- not waste token 
- LLM not seeing unnessary instruction in it's context for a task


A subagent is an instance of the main agent with  
- a custom system prompt
- a custom tools list
- a custom hooks list

## script-agent
+teaching-style +theme 
- system: src\prompts\scriptagent_system.md
- tools: read, write, edits
- hooks: none

## html is generated by the main agent still
+theme +teaching-style


# Intendted Workflow
user prompt -(agent)> scriptagent(req-prompt) -> script.md

* scriptagent [deterministic flow]:
LLM(ansgen-system, teaching-style, req-prompt, vid-len) -> answer -> write(answer, answer.md)
LLM(scriptgen-system, teaching-style, theme, answer, req-prompt, vid-len) -> script -> write(script, script.md)

script.md -(agent)> read(script.md) -(agent)> write(index.html)
